summary: Greetings! I am a Forward Deployed AI Engineer & Senior Technical Specialist with {{yearsOfExperience}} years of experience delivering web, mobile, business intelligence, and production-grade AI solutions. Proficient in Python, Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI Agents, .NET Core, Angular, React.js, ASP.NET MVC, Android Studio, and SQL/NoSQL databases (MS SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure CosmosDB). Highly experienced in Azure cloud services (Web Apps, Functions, Service Bus, AI Search, SQL, API Gateway, VM Automation, Blob Storage, SendGrid), DevOps practices, Docker and Kubernetes. Certified as a Google Cloud Professional Cloud Developer and MongoDB SI Associate.

projects.title: Review Agent
projects.summary: AI Agent-powered document review agent that validates up to 15 uploaded documents (20 MB each), including two required Word primary documents. Configurable rules are evaluated per primary document with live, rule-by-rule Pass/Fail results, concise summaries, and a Word report with tracked changes.
